ActorTalk: Hello there! We're the Neo-Modern Art Association, and we're currently exhibiting classical art.
That's right! Our association's motto is "no limits"—freedom is our style. As long as you want to, you could even exhibit a blank sheet of paper.
So we don't do things like require our members to follow some unified creative style!
So it's basically a club where you can do anything?
That's right. After all, the academy is already here to teach combat knowledge.
All our association needs to be is a sanctuary where everyone can relax.
That's what we, the Neo-Modern Art Association, are! Love and peace!
